blockingIssues.description: Missing palette select sync after initTheme(). The original inline initTheme() synced #lightPaletteSelect.value and #darkPaletteSelect.value with localStorage values after setting data attributes. The shared initTheme() from theme.js does NOT sync select elements (it was designed for index.html/promotion.html which lack palette selects). On page load, the palette dropdowns always show 'github' (the HTML default) regardless of stored preferences. This violates VAL-THEME-005. Fix: add 4 lines after initTheme() call in start-app.js to sync select values from localStorage.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document that shared initTheme() does NOT sync palette <select> element values — it only sets data-* attributes on documentElement. Pages with palette selects (currently only start.html) must sync select values themselves after calling initTheme().
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature extract-start-html-inline-js dropped the palette select sync when replacing local initTheme with shared initTheme. The shared function in src/js/shared/theme.js:29-52 has no select sync logic.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add verification step: when extracting code that syncs UI state with localStorage on load, verify that all state-dependent UI elements (selects, checkboxes, radio buttons) are properly synced after the shared initialization function runs. Specifically check that select.value matches localStorage values, not just that data attributes are set.
